text.p: EchoStar Communications said Wednesday it completed an offering of $375 million of senior secured notes.

It said net proceeds from the sale of the 12-1/2 percent notes, expected to be $364.0 million, will be used to fund the construction, launch and insurance of EchoStar IV, a new satellite scheduled to be launched in the first quarter of 1998.
Part of the money raised will also be used to pay for another satellite, Echostar III, which is currently scheduled to be launched in September, it said.
It said the offering was underwritten by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Lehman Bros.
It said it will file a registration statement with the SEC within 30 days to provide for the exchange of the notes for the company's publicly traded securities.
